schema: CREATE TABLE "Sensors" ("sensor_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "cluster_val" REAL, "reading_val" REAL, "coord_x" REAL, "coord_y" REAL, CHECK ("cluster_val" >= 0), CHECK ("reading_val" >= 0));
correct_query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(reading_val), 2) AS total_reading FROM Sensors WHERE cluster_val IN (SELECT cluster_val FROM Sensors GROUP BY cluster_val HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND (coord_x, coord_y) IN (SELECT coord_x, coord_y FROM Sensors WHERE NOT coord_x IS NULL AND NOT coord_y IS NULL GROUP BY coord_x, coord_y HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces tuple membership (coord_x, coord_y) IN (SELECT coord_x, coord_y ...) with string concatenation coord_x || coord_y IN (SELECT coord_x || coord_y ...)
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH SharedClusters AS (SELECT cluster_val FROM Sensors GROUP BY cluster_val HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), UniqueCoords AS (SELECT coord_x, coord_y FROM Sensors GROUP BY coord_x, coord_y HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) SELECT ROUND(SUM(reading_val), 2) AS total_reading FROM Sensors WHERE cluster_val IN (SELECT cluster_val FROM SharedClusters) AND coord_x || coord_y IN (SELECT coord_x || coord_y FROM UniqueCoords)

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Groups by concatenated coord_x || coord_y with HAVING COUNT(coord_x || coord_y) = 1 instead of tuple GROUP BY coord_x, coord_y
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH ClusterMatches AS (SELECT S1.sensor_id FROM Sensors AS S1 JOIN Sensors AS S2 ON S1.cluster_val = S2.cluster_val WHERE S1.sensor_id <> S2.sensor_id), UniqueCoordConcat AS (SELECT sensor_id FROM Sensors GROUP BY coord_x || coord_y HAVING COUNT(coord_x || coord_y) = 1) SELECT ROUND(SUM(reading_val), 2) AS total_reading FROM Sensors WHERE sensor_id IN (SELECT * FROM ClusterMatches) AND sensor_id IN (SELECT * FROM UniqueCoordConcat)
